Extract Twitter card meta tags

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:h2m/h2m.dart';
import 'package:h2m/src/html_to_markdown_rs_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final options = await createConversionOptionsFromJson(json: '{}');
    final result = await H2mBridge.convert('<html><head><meta name="twitter:card" content="summary_large_image"><meta name="twitter:site" content="@examplesite"><meta name="twitter:title" content="Twitter Card Title"><meta name="twitter:description" content="Twitter card description."><meta name="twitter:image" content="https://example.com/twitter-image.jpg"></head><body><p>Content</p></body></html>', options: options);
    stdout.writeln(result.content);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.twitterCard["card"]);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.twitterCard["title"]);
    stdout.writeln(result.metadata.document.twitterCard["description"]);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
